verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client, not a VPN or overlay-network product, so advertising subnet routes to reach other devices is outside its category. Its documented SSH tunnels (-L) and ProxyCommand are per-port forwarding, a related but different feature, and do not make subnet routing applicable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use subnet routers to reach devices outside my local network as if I were on it
